title: The Five-Minute House
description: A teaching scenario from README-WORLDBUILDING.md: one exterior, one hallway, one locked study, one key, one clue, one NPC.

triggers.event: Every candle in the house gutters out at once

house_exterior.name: Outside the House
house_exterior.description: A narrow terrace house with curtains that never move.
house_exterior.first_visit: Rain has polished the front steps. The door knocker is a brass hand, and the fingers are a little too long.
house_exterior.revisit: The brass hand knocker waits where you left it. The rain has not stopped.

details.knocker: A brass hand, green with age, fingers slightly too long.

house_hallway.name: Hallway
house_hallway.description: A narrow hallway that smells of dust and dried lavender.
house_hallway.first_visit: The door sighs shut behind you. Dust hangs in the air like it was disturbed a moment ago, and under the dust, dried lavender.
house_hallway.revisit: Dust and lavender. The study door waits at the end of the hall.

details.runner_rug: A threadbare runner rug, worn more on the left side, as if something is often dragged toward the study.

house_study.name: Study
house_study.description: A cramped study. Every flat surface carries stacks of paper covered in tally marks.
house_study.first_visit: The lamp is still warm. Tally marks cover every page, every envelope, the margin of the newspaper — and they stop mid-stroke.
house_study.revisit: The tally marks have not moved. You check. You keep checking.

details.tally_marks: Groups of five, over and over. The last group has only four.

items.name: Brass Key
items.description: A heavy brass key, recently oiled.

items.name: Torn Letter
items.description: Half a letter. The ink has run where it got wet: '...do not let him finish the counting...'

timeline.event: The knocking starts under the floor
